units.zh: 卷七十九 馮奉世傳第四十九
units.en: Volume 79: Biography of Feng Fengshi, the forty-ninth.
units.literal: Volume 79, Biography of Feng Fengshi, Number 49.

units.zh: 馮奉世字子明，上黨潞人也，徙杜陵。
units.en: Feng Fengshi, style Ziming, came from Lu in Shangdang and later settled at Duling.
units.literal: Feng Fengshi, courtesy name Ziming, was a man of Lu in Shangdang; his family moved to Duling.

units.zh: 其先馮亭，為韓上黨守。
units.en: His forebear Feng Ting had held Shangdang for the state of Han.
units.literal: His ancestor was Feng Ting, who was governor of Shangdang for Han.

units.zh: 秦攻上黨，絕太行道，韓不能守，馮亭乃入上黨城守於趙。
units.en: When Qin severed the Taihang passes and Han could not defend the commandery, Feng Ting turned the territory over to Zhao and defended it in Zhao's name.
units.literal: Qin attacked Shangdang, cut the Taihang road, and Han could not hold it; Feng Ting thereupon entered the city of Shangdang and held it for Zhao.

units.zh: 趙封馮亭為華陽君，與趙將括距秦，戰死於長平。
units.en: Zhao enfeoffed him as lord of Huayang; he fought beside the general Zhao Kuo against Qin and fell at Changping.
units.literal: Zhao ennobled Feng Ting as lord of Huayang; with the Zhao general Kuo he resisted Qin and died in battle at Changping.

units.zh: 宗族由是分散，或留潞，或在趙。
units.en: The clan scattered; one branch stayed in Lu, another in Zhao.
units.literal: The lineage was thereby scattered; some remained in Lu, some were in Zhao.

units.zh: 在趙者為官帥將，官帥將子為代相。
units.en: The Zhao branch produced garrison commanders, and a commander's son rose to chancellor of Dai.
units.literal: Those in Zhao became commanders of garrison officers; a son of a garrison commander became chancellor of Dai.

units.zh: 及秦滅六國，而馮亭之後馮毋擇、馮去疾、馮劫皆為秦將相焉。
units.en: After Qin swallowed the rival kingdoms, Feng Ting's descendants Wuzhe, Quji, and Jie all served Qin as generals and ministers.
units.literal: When Qin extinguished the six states, descendants of Feng Ting—Feng Wuzhe, Feng Quji, and Feng Jie—all became generals and ministers of Qin.

units.zh: 漢興，文帝時馮唐顯名，即代相子也。
units.en: Under Han, Feng Tang won renown under Emperor Wen—he was that chancellor of Dai's son.
units.literal: When Han arose, in Emperor Wen's time Feng Tang became famous; he was the son of the chancellor of Dai.

units.zh: 至武帝末，奉世以良家子選為郎。
units.en: Near the end of Emperor Wu's reign he was chosen from a respectable household and entered service as a court gentleman.
units.literal: By the end of Emperor Wu's reign, Fengshi was selected from a good family to serve as a court gentleman.

units.zh: 昭帝時，以功次補武安長。
units.en: Under Emperor Zhao he earned appointment as magistrate of Wu'an by seniority of service.
units.literal: In Emperor Zhao's time, by order of merit he was appointed magistrate of Wu'an.

units.zh: 失官，年三十餘矣，乃學《春秋》涉大義，讀兵法明習，前將軍韓增奏以為軍司空令。
units.en: Stripped of rank past thirty, he mastered the Spring and Autumn, absorbed its large themes, and pored over strategy until the former general Han Zeng nominated him as director of the army works command.
units.literal: He lost office; already past thirty, he then studied the Spring and Autumn Annals and grasped its great principles, read military texts until expert, and the former general Han Zeng memorialized to appoint him director of the army works command.

units.zh: 本始中，從軍擊匈奴。
units.en: During Benshi he campaigned with the host against the Xiongnu.
units.literal: In the Benshi period he followed the army to strike the Xiongnu.

units.zh: 軍罷，復為郎。
units.en: After demobilization he returned to the gentleman corps.
units.literal: When the army was disbanded, he again became a gentleman.

units.zh: 先是時，漢數出使西域，多辱命不稱，或貪污，為外國所苦。
units.en: Han envoys to the Western Regions had often failed or grown rich at local expense, to the outer states' misery.
units.literal: Earlier, Han had repeatedly sent envoys to the Western Regions; many disgraced their commissions or proved unworthy, some were corrupt, and the outer states suffered for it.

units.zh: 是時，烏孫大有擊匈奴之功，而西域諸國新輯，漢方善遇，欲以安之，選可使外國者。
units.en: Wusun had lately bloodied the Xiongnu, the Tarim states were settling under Han favor, and the court wanted a trustworthy envoy.
units.literal: At that time Wusun had achieved great merit in striking the Xiongnu, while the states of the Western Regions had newly been brought to order; Han was treating them generously and wished to pacify them, and therefore selected one who could be sent abroad.

units.zh: 前將軍增舉奉世以衛候使持節送大宛諸國客。
units.en: Han Zeng nominated him as guard commandant bearing the staff to convoy Ferghana's party and the rest.
units.literal: The former general Han Zeng recommended Fengshi as guard commandant with staff of authority to escort the guests of Ferghana and the other states.

units.zh: 至伊脩城，都尉宋將言莎車與旁國共攻殺漢所置莎車王萬年，並殺漢使者奚充國。
units.en: At Yixiu the local commandant Song Jiang warned that Shache and allies had murdered Wannian, Han's puppet king of Shache, and slaughtered envoy Xi Chongguo.
units.literal: When he reached Yixiu city, commandant Song Jiang reported that Shache together with neighboring states had jointly attacked and killed Wannian, the king of Shache whom Han had installed, and had also killed Han's envoy Xi Chongguo.

units.zh: 時，匈奴又發兵攻車師城，不能下而去。
units.en: The Xiongnu had just besieged Jushi without success and marched away.
units.literal: At that time the Xiongnu had again sent troops to attack the city of Jushi but could not take it and withdrew.

units.zh: 莎車遣使揚言北道諸國已屬匈奴矣，於是攻劫南道，與歃盟畔漢，從鄯善以西皆絕不通。
units.en: Shache's envoys proclaimed that the states of the northern route already belonged to the Xiongnu; they then raided the southern route, swore a blood-oath alliance, rebelled against Han, and cut off communication west of Shanshan.
units.literal: Shache sent envoys to boast that the states of the northern route already belonged to the Xiongnu; thereupon it raided the southern route, smeared blood in alliance, rebelled against Han, and from Shanshan westward all communication was cut.

units.zh: 都護鄭吉、校尉司馬意皆在北道諸國間。
units.en: Protector-general Zheng Ji and colonel Sima Yi were tied up on the northern line.
units.literal: The protector-general Zheng Ji and colonel Sima Yi were both among the states of the northern route.

units.zh: 奉世與其副嚴昌計，以為不亟擊之則莎車日強，其勢難制，必危西域。
units.en: Fengshi and deputy Yan Chang judged that delay would let Shache swell until the whole region slipped from Han control.
units.literal: Fengshi and his deputy Yan Chang planned, holding that unless they struck quickly Shache would grow stronger day by day, its power hard to control, and the Western Regions would surely be endangered.

units.zh: 遂以節諭告諸國王，因發其兵，南北道合萬五千人進擊莎車，攻拔其城。
units.en: He invoked the staff, rallied the kings, and raised fifteen thousand men from both routes to storm Shache and take its walls.
units.literal: Thereupon with the staff he issued proclamations to the kings of the states and mobilized their troops; the northern and southern routes combined fifteen thousand men and advanced to attack Shache, storming and taking its city.

units.zh: 莎車王自殺，傳其首詣長安。
units.en: The Shache king committed suicide; his head went to Chang'an.
units.literal: The king of Shache killed himself; his head was sent to Chang'an.

units.zh: 諸國悉平，威振西域。
units.en: The oases submitted; his name thundered across the Tarim.
units.literal: All the states were pacified; his might shook the Western Regions.

units.zh: 奉世乃罷兵以聞。
units.en: Fengshi stood the army down and memorialized what he had done.
units.literal: Fengshi thereupon disbanded the troops and reported the matter.

units.zh: 宣帝召見韓增，曰：「賀將軍所舉得其人。」
units.en: Emperor Xuan called in Han Zeng and said, "Your nomination was sound."
units.literal: Emperor Xuan summoned Han Zeng and said, "We congratulate the general on recommending the right man."

units.zh: 奉世遂西至大苑。
units.en: He then pushed on west to Ferghana.
units.literal: Fengshi thereupon proceeded west to Ferghana.

units.zh: 大苑聞其斬莎車王，敬之異於它使。
units.en: Ferghana, learning he had decapitated the Shache king, treated him with a respect no other envoy had known.
units.literal: Ferghana, hearing that he had beheaded the king of Shache, honored him differently from other envoys.

units.zh: 得其名馬象龍而還。
units.en: He brought back the celebrated "Elephant Dragon" steed.
units.literal: He obtained their famous horse "Elephant Dragon" and returned.

units.zh: 上甚說，下議封奉世。
units.en: The throne was delighted and ordered discussion of a fief for Fengshi.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and sent the matter down for deliberation on enfeoffing Fengshi.

units.zh: 丞相、將軍皆曰：「《春秋》之義，大夫出疆，有可以安國家，則顓之可也。
units.en: The chancellor and the generals all said, "According to the principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals, when a grandee goes beyond the borders, he may act on his own authority if doing so can secure the state.
units.literal: The chancellor and the generals all said, "By the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, when a grandee goes beyond the frontier, if there is something by which the state can be secured, specialized authority is permissible.

units.zh: 奉世功傚尤著，宜加爵士之賞。」
units.en: Fengshi's achievement stood out; he deserved noble rank and a fief."
units.literal: Fengshi's merit and effect were especially conspicuous; he should receive reward of rank and fief."

units.zh: 少府蕭望之獨以奉世奉使有指，而擅矯制違命，發諸國兵，雖有功效，不可以為後法。
units.en: Xiao Wangzhi alone argued that Fengshi had carried fixed orders yet counterfeited an imperial rescript and mobilized foreign troops without warrant—precedent-making even if successful.
units.literal: Junior privy treasurer Xiao Wangzhi alone held that Fengshi had gone on mission with definite orders, yet on his own forged an edict and disobeyed command in raising the troops of the states; though there was merit and effect, it cannot be taken as a precedent for later.

units.zh: 即封奉世，開後奉使者利，以奉世為比，爭逐發兵，要功萬里之外，為國家生事於夷狄。
units.en: Ennobling him would tempt every future envoy to raise armies for glory ten thousand li away and embroil the court in barbarian quarrels.
units.literal: If Fengshi is enfeoffed, it opens the way for later envoys to profit, taking Fengshi as their model, competing to raise troops and seek merit beyond ten thousand li, thereby creating trouble for the state among the Yi and Di.

units.zh: 漸不可長，奉世不宜受封。
units.en: Such habits must not be fed; Fengshi should not take a fief.
units.literal: What gradually grows must not be encouraged; Fengshi should not receive a fief.

units.zh: 上善望之議，以奉世為光祿大夫、水衡都尉。
units.en: The emperor took Wangzhi's side, naming Fengshi grand counselor of the palace and superintendent of the palace parks instead.
units.literal: The emperor approved Wangzhi's proposal and appointed Fengshi grand counselor of the palace and superintendent of the palace parks.

units.zh: 元帝即位，為執金吾。
units.en: Under Emperor Yuan he became metropolitan commandant.
units.literal: When Emperor Yuan ascended the throne, he became metropolitan commandant.

units.zh: 上郡屬國歸義降胡萬餘人反去。
units.en: Over ten thousand surrendered Xiongnu of Shang commandery's dependent state rose and bolted.
units.literal: More than ten thousand surrendered Hu of the dependent state of Shang commandery rebelled and fled.

units.zh: 初，昭帝末，西河屬國胡伊酋若王亦將眾數千人畔，奉世輒持節將兵追擊。
units.en: Near the end of Emperor Zhao's reign the Xihe dependent chieftain Yijiuoru had mutinied with thousands; Fengshi had seized the staff and run him down.
units.literal: Earlier, at the end of Emperor Zhao's reign, the Xiongnu noble Yijiuoru king of the dependent state of Xihe also led several thousand followers in rebellion; Fengshi immediately took the staff and led troops in pursuit.

units.zh: 右將軍典屬國常惠薨，奉世代為右將軍典屬國，加諸吏之號。
units.en: When right general Chang Hui died, Fengshi succeeded him as right general and director of dependent states, with the collective title "various officials."
units.literal: When the right general and director of dependent states Chang Hui died, Fengshi replaced him as right general and director of dependent states, with the added title of various officials.

units.zh: 數歲，為光祿勳。
units.en: A few years later he rose to superintendent of the household.
units.literal: After several years he became superintendent of the household.

units.zh: 永光二年秋，隴西羌□姐旁種反，詔召丞相韋玄成、御史大夫鄭弘、大司馬車騎將軍王接、左將軍許嘉、右將軍奉世入議。
units.en: Yongguang 2 autumn: Longxi Qiang of the Xianjie confederation (the manuscript loses one character in the name) rose in revolt; the edict called Chancellor Wei Xuancheng, Counselor Zheng Hong, Grand Marshal Wang Jie, Left General Xu Jia, and Right General Fengshi to council.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Yongguang, the Qiang of Longxi, the tribal confederation beside the Xianjie [one graph missing in the text], rebelled; an edict summoned Chancellor Wei Xuancheng, Imperial Counselor Zheng Hong, grand marshal and chariot-and-cavalry general Wang Jie, left general Xu Jia, and right general Fengshi to enter and deliberate.

units.zh: 是時，歲比不登，京師谷石二百餘，邊郡四百，關東五百。
units.en: Years of bad harvests had driven grain past two hundred cash a bushel in the capital, four hundred on the frontier, five hundred in the east.
units.literal: At that time harvests had failed year after year; in the capital grain was over two hundred cash a bushel, on the border four hundred, east of the passes five hundred.

units.zh: 四方饑饉，朝廷方以為憂，而遭羌變。
units.en: Famine gripped the realm just as the court faced the Qiang crisis.
units.literal: Famine was everywhere; the court was already anxious, and then came the Qiang uprising.

units.zh: 玄成等漠然莫有對者。
units.en: Wei Xuancheng and the rest sat mute.
units.literal: Xuancheng and the others were blank and none had an answer.

units.zh: 奉世曰：「羌虜近在境內背畔，不以時誅，亡以威制遠蠻。
units.en: Fengshi said, "Qiang traitors are inside our border; crush them now or distant tribes will never fear Han.
units.literal: Fengshi said, "The Qiang raiders are close inside the borders in rebellion; unless they are executed in good time, there is no way to awe and control the distant Man.

units.zh: 臣願帥師討之。」
units.en: I ask command to chastise them."
units.literal: Your servant begs to lead an army to punish them."

units.zh: 上問用兵之數，對曰：「臣聞善用兵者，役不再興，糧不三載，故師不久暴而天誅亟決。
units.en: Asked the needed force, he answered: "A master of war does not mobilize twice nor haul grain three times; the blow must be swift.
units.literal: The emperor asked the scale of employing troops; he replied, saying, "Your servant has heard that those skilled in using troops do not twice raise levies nor thrice transport grain; therefore the army is not long exposed and Heaven's punishment is quickly settled.

units.zh: 往者數不料敵，而師至於折傷；
units.en: Past campaigns misread the foe and paid in blood;
units.literal: In the past several times the enemy was misjudged and the army reached the point of being broken and wounded;

units.zh: 再三發軵，則曠日煩費，威武虧矣。
units.en: repeat the levy and costs soar while prestige drains away.
units.literal: if repeatedly mobilized, days are wasted, expense mounts, and martial awesomeness is depleted.

units.zh: 今反虜無慮三萬人，法當倍用六萬人。
units.en: These rebels number perhaps thirty thousand; doctrine says double them—sixty thousand men.
units.literal: Now the rebel bandits number on the order of thirty thousand; by rule one should double that and use sixty thousand.

units.zh: 然羌戎弓矛之兵耳，器不犀利，可用四萬人，一月足以決。」
units.en: They are only bowmen and spearmen with dull gear; forty thousand can finish the job in a month."
units.literal: Yet the Qiang Rong are bow-and-spear troops; their weapons are not keen; forty thousand men can be used, and in one month it is sufficient to decide the affair."

units.zh: 丞相、御史、兩將軍皆以為民方收斂時，未可多發；
units.en: Chancellor, counselor, and both generals insisted the harvest forbade a large levy;
units.literal: The chancellor, imperial counselor, and both generals all held that the people were just in harvest season and many could not be sent;

units.zh: 萬人屯守之，且足。
units.en: ten thousand on the line would do for now.
units.literal: ten thousand men garrisoned on guard will for the moment suffice.

units.zh: 奉世曰：「不可。
units.en: Fengshi said, "That will not serve.
units.literal: Fengshi said, "It will not do.

units.zh: 天下被饑饉，士馬羸秏，守戰之備久廢不簡，夷狄皆有輕邊吏之心，而羌首難。
units.en: The realm is starving, mounts are gaunt, garrisons are rusty, barbarians despise frontier officers, and the Qiang chieftains have taken the lead in rebellion.
units.literal: The empire suffers famine; soldiers and horses are wasted and thin; preparations for defense and battle have long been neglected and not drilled; the Yi and Di all harbor contempt for border officials in their hearts, and the Qiang chieftains have taken the lead in rebellion.

units.zh: 今以萬人分屯數外，虜見兵少，必不畏懼，戰則挫兵病師，守則百姓不救。
units.en: Split ten thousand among several posts and the enemy will see weakness—attack and we shatter, stand fast and the people perish.
units.literal: Now if ten thousand men are divided to garrison several places, the raiders seeing few troops will surely not fear; if they fight, the troops will be broken and the army injured; if they defend, the common people will not be saved.

units.zh: 如此，怯弱之形見，羌人乘利，諸種並和，相扇而起，臣恐中國之役不得止於四萬，非財幣所能解也。
units.en: They will scent fear, clans will league, and I fear the war will outgrow forty thousand men and outrun any treasury.
units.literal: In this way a look of cowardice appears; the Qiang will seize the advantage, all kinds will join in harmony, fan one another, and rise together; your servant fears that service for the Middle Kingdom will not stop at forty thousand, nor can it be resolved with mere wealth and coin.

units.zh: 故少發師而曠日，與一舉而疾決，利害相萬也。」
units.en: A small force that drags on is nothing like one sharp stroke—the difference is an order of magnitude."
units.literal: Therefore to raise few troops and waste days versus to strike once and decide quickly—the benefit and harm are ten thousand apart."

units.zh: 固爭之，不能得。
units.en: He argued hard and lost.
units.literal: He firmly disputed it but could not prevail.

units.zh: 有詔益二千人。
units.en: The edict added only two thousand men.
units.literal: There was an edict to add two thousand men.

units.zh: 於是遣奉世將萬二千人騎，以將屯為名。
units.en: Fengshi marched with twelve thousand foot and cavalry under the label of garrison command.
units.literal: Thereupon Fengshi was dispatched leading twelve thousand foot and horse, in the name of commanding garrison troops.

units.zh: 典屬國任立、護軍都尉韓昌為偏裨，到隴西，分屯三處。
units.en: Ren Li, director of dependent states, and Han Chang, commandant of guards, were his lieutenants; in Longxi they split into three camps.
units.literal: Director of dependent states Ren Li and commandant of guards Han Chang served as wing commanders; reaching Longxi, they divided garrisons among three places.

units.zh: 典屬國為右軍，屯白石；
units.en: Ren Li took the right wing at Baishi;
units.literal: The director of dependent states was the right army, garrisoned at Baishi;

units.zh: 護軍都尉為前軍，屯臨洮；
units.en: Han Chang the vanguard at Lintao;
units.literal: the commandant of guards was the forward army, garrisoned at Lintao;

units.zh: 奉世為中軍，屯首陽西極上。
units.en: Fengshi held the center on the heights west of Shouyang.
units.literal: Fengshi was the central army, garrisoned at the western extremity above Shouyang.

units.zh: 前軍到降同阪，先遣校尉在前與羌爭地利，又別遣校尉救民於廣陽谷。
units.en: The vanguard reached Jiangtong Slope, sent a colonel to fight for ground, and another to evacuate civilians from Guangyang gorge.
units.literal: When the forward army reached the Jiangtong Slope, it first sent a colonel ahead to contest terrain with the Qiang, and separately sent a colonel to rescue commoners in the Guangyang ravine.

units.zh: 羌虜盛多，皆為所破，殺兩校尉。
units.en: The Qiang massed and overwhelmed both columns, killing the colonels.
units.literal: The Qiang raiders were numerous in strength; all were broken by them, and the two colonels were killed.

units.zh: 奉世具上地形部眾多少之計，願益三萬六千人乃足以決事。
units.en: Fengshi mapped terrain and tallies, begging for thirty-six thousand more men to finish the campaign.
units.literal: Fengshi fully reported upward the plan for terrain and the numbers of units, begging to add thirty-six thousand men and then it would be sufficient to settle the affair.

units.zh: 書奏，天子大為發兵六萬餘人，拜太常弋陽侯任千秋為奮武將軍以助焉。
units.en: The emperor mobilized more than sixty thousand reinforcements and named Grand Master Ren Qianqiu of Yiyang general Who Rouses Might to assist him.
units.literal: When the memorial was presented, the Son of Heaven on a large scale raised more than sixty thousand troops and appointed Grand Master of Ceremonies Marquis of Yiyang Ren Qianqiu as general Who Rouses Might to assist.

units.zh: 奉世上言：「願得其眾，不須煩大將。」
units.en: Fengshi wrote back, "Give me those men; no need for another grand commander."
units.literal: Fengshi submitted upward, saying, "Your servant begs to obtain those troops and has no need to trouble a great general."

units.zh: 因陳轉輸之費。
units.en: He itemized the cost of supply.
units.literal: Thereupon he set forth the costs of transport.

units.zh: 上於是以璽書勞奉世，且讓之，曰：「皇帝問將兵右將軍，甚苦暴露。
units.en: The throne answered with a sealed rescript both praising and scolding: "The emperor asks his right general: you have borne hard weather long.
units.literal: The emperor thereupon with a rescript on the imperial seal consoled Fengshi and also reproached him, saying, "The emperor asks the right general who leads troops: you have greatly suffered exposure in the open.

units.zh: 羌虜侵邊境，殺吏民，甚逆天道，故遣將軍帥士大夫行天誅。
units.en: The Qiang murder our people and offend Heaven; We send you to execute that sentence with gentry and troops.
units.literal: The Qiang raiders encroach on the border, kill officials and common people, greatly oppose Heaven's way; therefore We dispatch the general to lead gentlemen and officials to carry out Heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 以將軍材質之美，奮精兵，誅不軌，百下百全之道也。
units.en: Given your gifts and picked soldiers, lawless men should fall at the first blow.
units.literal: With the general's fine quality of stuff and wielding crack troops to execute the lawless, it is the way of a hundred descents and a hundred completenesses.

units.zh: 今乃有畔敵之名，大為中國羞。
units.en: Yet the army is matched against the foe—a deep shame to China.
units.literal: Now instead there is the reputation of matching the enemy, greatly shaming the Middle Kingdom.

units.zh: 以昔不閑習之故邪？
units.en: Is it want of training?
units.literal: Is it because of former lack of practice and drill?

units.zh: 以恩厚未洽，信約不明也？
units.en: Or because our kindness and clear pledges have not reached them?
units.literal: Or because favor and kindness have not fully penetrated, trust and covenant are not clear?

units.zh: 朕甚怪之。
units.en: We are much perplexed.
units.literal: We are greatly puzzled by it.

units.zh: 上書言羌虜依深山，多徑道，不得不多分部遮要害，須得後發營士，足以決事，部署已定，勢不可復置大將，聞之。
units.en: Your letter says the Qiang hold the heights and many trails, so you must split the army to seal choke points and wait for reinforcements to decide the fight; dispositions are set and a new high commander would only tangle them—We have read you.
units.literal: Your memorial states that the Qiang raiders rely on deep mountains and many bypaths, so you cannot but divide the army in many parts to block the critical points, and that you must await later-arriving camp troops to be sufficient to settle the affair; deployment is already fixed and the situation cannot again accommodate a great general—We have heard it.

units.zh: 前為將軍兵少，不足自守，故發近所騎，日夜詣，非為擊也。
units.en: We rushed local cavalry to you earlier because your numbers could not hold the line, not to take command of the attack from you.
units.literal: Earlier, because the general's troops were few and insufficient to guard yourselves, therefore We raised nearby cavalry, day and night hurrying to you—it was not for attack.

units.zh: 今發三輔、河東、弘農越騎、跡射、佽飛、彀者、羽林孤兒及呼速累、嗕種，方急遣。
units.en: We now press toward you the swift riders, trace archers, flying spears, crossbow specialists, palace orphans, and tribal auxiliaries from the capital districts, Hedong, and Hongnang.
units.literal: Now We are dispatching in urgent haste the swift riders, trace-and-shoot archers, flying spearmen, crossbowmen, Forest of Feathers orphans, and the Husuli and Ru tribes from the three adjuncts, Hedong, and Hongnang.

units.zh: 且兵，凶器也，必有成敗者，患策不豫定，料敵不審也，故復遣奮武將軍。
units.en: Arms are ill omens; victory turns on forethought and intelligence of the foe—hence the second general Who Rouses Might.
units.literal: Moreover troops are inauspicious instruments; there must be those who succeed or fail—the worry is that plans are not settled in advance and the enemy is not carefully gauged; therefore We again dispatch the general Who Rouses Might.

units.zh: 兵法曰大將軍出必有偏裨，所以揚威武，參計策，將軍又何疑焉？
units.en: The canon says every commander needs lieutenants to lend weight and counsel—do not take offense.
units.literal: Military texts say that when a great general goes out there must be wing commanders, whereby martial awesomeness is displayed and plans are consulted—why should the general doubt?

units.zh: 夫愛吏士，得眾心，舉而無悔，禽敵必全，將軍之職也。
units.en: Cherish the men, win their loyalty, strike without regret, and annihilate the foe—that is your charge.
units.literal: To cherish officers and soldiers, win the host's hearts, move without regret, and capture the enemy completely—this is a general's duty.

units.zh: 若乃轉輸之費，則有司存，將軍勿憂。
units.en: Supply is the ministries' problem, not yours.
units.literal: As for the costs of transport, the offices exist for that; let the general not worry.

units.zh: 須奮武將軍兵到，合擊羌虜。」
units.en: Stand until Who Rouses Might arrives, then crush the Qiang together."
units.literal: Await the arrival of the troops of the general Who Rouses Might and jointly strike the Qiang raiders."

units.zh: 十月，兵畢至隴西。
units.en: By the tenth month every column had reached Longxi.
units.literal: In the tenth month the troops had all reached Longxi.

units.zh: 十一月，並進。
units.en: In the eleventh month they attacked as one.
units.literal: In the eleventh month they advanced together.

units.zh: 羌虜大破，斬首數千級，餘皆走出塞。
units.en: The Qiang broke; thousands fell, the rest bolted beyond the wall.
units.literal: The Qiang raiders were greatly broken; several thousand heads were cut off, and the rest all fled out beyond the passes.

units.zh: 兵未決間，漢復發募士萬人，拜定襄太守韓安國為建威將軍。
units.en: Mid-campaign Han raised another ten thousand recruits and named Dingxiang governor Han Anguo general Who Establishes Might.
units.literal: While the issue was not yet decided, Han again issued a call for ten thousand volunteers and appointed governor of Dingxiang Han Anguo as general Who Establishes Might.

units.zh: 未進，聞羌破，還。
units.en: Han Anguo turned back when he heard the Qiang had collapsed.
units.literal: Before he advanced, hearing that the Qiang were broken, he returned.

units.zh: 上曰：「羌虜破散創艾，亡逃出塞，其罷吏士，頗留屯田，備要害處。」
units.en: The emperor said, "The Qiang are shattered; demobilize the host but leave enough men to farm the garrisons and hold the choke points."
units.literal: The emperor said, "The Qiang raiders are broken and scattered, wounded and in flight, escaping beyond the passes; dismiss the officers and soldiers, but rather leave many to garrison fields and guard critical points."

units.zh: 明年二月，奉世還京師，更為左將軍光祿勳如故。
units.en: The next year, second month, he reached the capital, restored as left general and superintendent of the household.
units.literal: In the second month of the following year Fengshi returned to the capital and was again made left general and superintendent of the household as before.

units.zh: 其後錄功拜爵，下詔曰：「羌虜桀黠，賊害吏民，攻隴西府寺，燔燒置亭，絕道橋，甚逆天道。
units.en: Merit rolls later brought an edict: "The Qiang are savage foes who slew our people, torched Longxi yamen and post houses, and cut bridges—Heaven's enemies.
units.literal: Afterward his merit was recorded and noble rank granted; an edict said, "The Qiang raiders are cruel and cunning, injuring officials and common people, attacking Longxi offices, burning relay stations, cutting roads and bridges, greatly opposing Heaven's way.

units.zh: 左將軍光祿勳奉世前將兵征討，斬捕首虜八千餘級，鹵馬、牛、羊以萬數。
units.en: Left General Fengshi took the field, took over eight thousand heads, and drove off countless stock.
units.literal: Left general and superintendent of the household Fengshi formerly led troops in campaign and strike, beheading and capturing more than eight thousand heads, and seizing horses, oxen, and sheep by the ten thousands.

units.zh: 賜奉世爵關內侯，良邑五百戶，黃金六十斤。」
units.en: We grant him marquis-within-the-passes rank, five hundred good households, and sixty jin of gold."
units.literal: Let Fengshi be granted rank of marquis within the passes, good fief of five hundred households, and sixty jin of gold."

units.zh: 裨將、校尉三十餘人，皆拜。
units.en: Over thirty subordinate generals and colonels received titles with him.
units.literal: More than thirty lieutenant generals and colonels were all ennobled.

units.zh: 後歲餘，奉世病卒。
units.en: A year or so later he died of illness.
units.literal: After a little more than a year Fengshi died of illness.

units.zh: 居爪牙官前後十年，為折衝宿將，功名次趙充國。
units.en: For a full decade he held claw-and-fang office at court—a veteran who broke enemy assaults—second in merit only to Zhao Chongguo.
units.literal: He held fang-and-claw offices for ten years running, a veteran general who broke enemy assaults; in order of merit he ranked next to Zhao Chongguo.

units.zh: 奮武將軍任千秋者，其父宮，昭帝時以丞相征事捕斬反者左將軍上官桀，封侯，宣帝時為太常，薨。
units.en: Ren Qianqiu's father Ren Gong had served Emperor Zhao's chancellor as investigator, cut down mutineer Shangguan Jie, taken a marquisate, and ended as Grand Master of ceremonies under Xuan.
units.literal: General Who Rouses Might Ren Qianqiu—his father was Ren Gong, who in Emperor Zhao's time, as investigating clerk to the chancellor, captured and beheaded the rebel left general Shangguan Jie, was ennobled marquis, became Grand Master of ceremonies under Emperor Xuan, and died.

units.zh: 千秋嗣後，復為太常。
units.en: Qianqiu inherited the fief and likewise rose to Grand Master of ceremonies.
units.literal: Qianqiu inherited afterward and again became Grand Master of ceremonies.

units.zh: 成帝時，樂昌侯王商代奉世為左將軍，而千秋為右將軍，後亦為左將軍。
units.en: Under Cheng, Wang Shang of Lechang succeeded Fengshi as left general while Qianqiu held the right, then moved left in turn.
units.literal: In Emperor Cheng's time Marquis of Lechang Wang Shang replaced Fengshi as left general, while Qianqiu was right general; later he too became left general.

units.zh: 子孫傳國，至王莽乃絕云。
units.en: The line held the marquisate until Wang Mang ended it.
units.literal: Sons and grandsons transmitted the state until Wang Mang, when it was cut off.

units.zh: 奉世死後二年，西域都護甘延壽以誅郅支單于封為列侯。
units.en: Two years after Fengshi died, Gan Yanshou won a full marquisate for killing Zhizhi.
units.literal: Two years after Fengshi's death, protector-general of the Western Regions Gan Yanshou was ennobled full marquis for executing Chanyu Zhizhi.

units.zh: 時，丞相匡衡亦用延壽矯制生事，據蕭望之前議，以為不當封，而議者咸美其功，上從眾而侯之。
units.en: Chancellor Kuang Heng echoed Wangzhi's old line that Yanshou had overstepped, yet public praise swayed the throne and Yanshou was ennobled.
units.literal: At the time Chancellor Kuang Heng also cited Yanshou's forging an edict and creating trouble, relying on Xiao Wangzhi's earlier argument, and held that he should not be enfeoffed, but debaters all praised his merit, and the emperor followed the multitude and made him marquis.

units.zh: 於是杜欽上疏，追訟奉世前功曰：「前莎車王殺漢使者，約諸國背畔。
units.en: Du Qin then memorialized, retrospectively pleading Fengshi's earlier merit, saying, "Formerly the king of Shache killed Han's envoy and bound the states in rebellion.
units.literal: Thereupon Du Qin submitted a memorial, retrospectively pleading Fengshi's earlier merit, saying, "Formerly the king of Shache killed Han's envoy and bound the states in rebellion.

units.zh: 左將軍奉世以衛候便宜發兵誅莎車王，策定城郭，功施邊境。
units.en: Left General Fengshi, then serving as guard commandant, had on convenient authority raised troops and executed the Shache king, settled the walled towns, and extended his merit to the border.
units.literal: Left general Fengshi, as guard commandant, on convenient authority raised troops and executed the king of Shache, settled strategy for the walled towns, and his merit reached the border.

units.zh: 議者以奉世奉使有指，《春秋》之義亡遂事，漢家之法有矯制，故不得侯。
units.en: Critics said he had fixed orders, the Annals did not ratify after the fact, and Han law punished forged rescripts—hence no fief.
units.literal: Debaters held that Fengshi had gone on mission with definite orders, that by the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals one does not ratify after the fact, and that Han law has the article on forging edicts; therefore he could not be made marquis.

units.zh: 令匈奴郅支單于殺漢使者，亡保康居，都護延壽發城郭兵屯田吏士四萬餘人以誅斬之，封為列侯。
units.en: Yet Zhizhi murdered an envoy and fled to Kangju; Yanshou led forty thousand colonists and garrison troops to kill him—and took a full marquisate.
units.literal: Now the Xiongnu Chanyu Zhizhi has killed Han's envoy, fled for refuge to Kangju, and the protector-general Yanshou raised more than forty thousand men of the walled towns and garrison-field officers and soldiers to execute and behead him, and he is enfeoffed full marquis.

units.zh: 臣愚以為比罪則郅支薄，量敵則莎車眾，用師則奉世寡，計勝則奉世為功於邊境安，慮敗則延壽為禍於國家深。
units.en: Zhizhi's guilt was slighter, Shache's coalition larger, Fengshi's army smaller; success made Fengshi the border's shield, failure would have made Yanshou a heavier national disaster.
units.literal: Your servant foolishly holds that comparing crimes Zhizhi's is lighter, measuring enemies Shache's host was larger, using troops Fengshi's were fewer; reckoning victory Fengshi's merit was in securing the border, considering defeat Yanshou's harm to the state was deeper.

units.zh: 其違命而擅生事同，延壽割地封，而奉世獨不錄。
units.en: Both broke orders to act; one was carved a fief, the other erased from the rolls.
units.literal: In disobeying orders and on their own creating trouble they are the same; Yanshou was granted land enfeoffment while Fengshi alone is not recorded.

units.zh: 臣聞功同賞異則勞臣疑，罪鈞刑殊則百姓惑；
units.en: Equal deeds and unequal rewards breed suspicion in loyal ministers; equal crimes and unequal sentences confuse the people;
units.literal: Your servant has heard that when merit is the same but rewards differ, laboring ministers doubt; when guilt is even but punishments differ, the hundred surnames are perplexed;

units.zh: 疑生無常，惑生不知所從；
units.en: doubt unmoors duty, confusion leaves them nowhere to turn;
units.literal: from doubt arises lack of constancy, from perplexity arises not knowing which way to follow;

units.zh: 亡常則節趨不立，不知所從則百姓無所措手足。
units.en: without a fixed standard virtue cannot root, and the common folk flounder.
units.literal: lack of constancy means integrity and tendency do not stand; not knowing which way to follow means the hundred surnames have nowhere to put hand or foot.

units.zh: 奉世圖難忘死，信命殊俗，威功白著，為世使表，獨抑厭而不揚，非聖主所以塞疑厲節之意也。
units.en: Fengshi risked death in barbarian lands and his glory shone—an exemplar for every envoy—yet the court buries him; that is no way for a sage king to clear doubt and steel character.
units.literal: Fengshi planned through hardship and forgot death, trusted his fate among alien customs; his awesomeness and merit were plain for the world, a model for envoys—yet alone he is suppressed and not celebrated; this is not the meaning by which a sage ruler blocks doubt and sharpens integrity.

units.zh: 願下有司議。」
units.en: I ask the ministries to reconsider."
units.literal: I beg that it be sent down to the offices for deliberation."

units.zh: 上以先帝時事，不復錄。
units.en: The emperor let the old case lie as a prior reign's affair.
units.literal: The emperor, because it was a matter of the late emperor's time, did not again record it.

units.zh: 奉世有子男九人，女四人。
units.en: Fengshi fathered nine sons and four daughters.
units.literal: Fengshi had nine sons and four daughters.

units.zh: 長女媛以選充兵宮，為元帝昭儀，產中山孝王。
units.en: His eldest daughter Yuan was selected for the palace women's quarters, became Brilliant Companion to Emperor Yuan, and bore the filial king of Zhongshan.
units.literal: The eldest daughter Yuan was selected to enter the palace women's quarters, became a Brilliant Companion to Emperor Yuan, and bore the filial king of Zhongshan.

units.zh: 元帝崩，媛為中山太后，隨王就國。
units.en: When Emperor Yuan died she became dowager of Zhongshan and went with her son to his fief.
units.literal: When Emperor Yuan died, Yuan became grand empress dowager of Zhongshan and followed the king to his state.

units.zh: 奉世長子譚，太常舉孝廉為郎，功次補天水司馬。
units.en: Eldest son Tan, filial and incorrupt from the Grand Master of ceremonies' nomination, became a gentleman and then Tianshui marshal by seniority.
units.literal: Fengshi's eldest son Tan was recommended filial and incorrupt by the Grand Master of ceremonies and became a gentleman, then by order of merit was appointed marshal of Tianshui.

units.zh: 奉世擊西羌，譚為校尉，隨父從軍有功，未拜病死。
units.en: Tan served as colonel in the Qiang war and earned merit beside his father, then died of sickness before promotion.
units.literal: When Fengshi struck the Western Qiang, Tan was a colonel; following his father in the army he had merit, but before appointment he died of illness.

units.zh: 譚弟野王、逡、立、參至大官。
units.en: Younger brothers Yewang, Qun, Li, and Shen all rose high.
units.literal: Tan's younger brothers Yewang, Qun, Li, and Shen reached high office.

units.zh: 野王字君卿，受業博士，通《詩》。
units.en: Yewang, style Junqing, studied under an erudite and mastered the Odes.
units.literal: Yewang, courtesy name Junqing, received instruction from an erudite and was conversant with the Odes.

units.zh: 少以父任為太子中庶子。
units.en: As a youth he entered the heir apparent's household by yin privilege.
units.literal: In youth by his father's privilege he became attendant to the heir apparent for the inner court.

units.zh: 年十八，上書願試守長安令。
units.en: At eighteen he volunteered to trial-run the magistracy of Chang'an.
units.literal: At age eighteen he submitted a memorial begging to be tried as acting magistrate of Chang'an.

units.zh: 宣帝奇其志，問丞相魏相，相以為不可許。
units.en: Emperor Xuan admired the audacity; Chancellor Wei Xiang said no.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan marveled at his ambition and asked Chancellor Wei Xiang, who held it could not be permitted.

units.zh: 後以功次補當陽長，遷為櫟陽令，徙夏陽令。
units.en: He later rose through Dangyang, Liyang, and Xiayang by merit.
units.literal: Later by order of merit he was appointed magistrate of Dangyang, was promoted magistrate of Liyang, and transferred magistrate of Xiayang.

units.zh: 元帝時，遷隴西太守，以治行高，入為左馮翊。
units.en: Under Yuan he governed Longxi with such distinction that the capital made him left governor of Fengyi.
units.literal: In Emperor Yuan's time he was promoted governor of Longxi; because his administration was high in quality, he entered as left governor of Fengyi.

units.zh: 歲餘，而池陽令並素行貪污，輕野王外戚年少，治行不改。
units.en: A year in, Chiyang magistrate Bing, a grafter, sneered at Yewang as a young in-law and kept stealing.
units.literal: After more than a year, the magistrate of Chiyang, Bing, by nature corrupt in conduct, despised Yewang as a young maternal relative of the consort and did not reform his administration.

units.zh: 野王部督郵掾示殳祤趙都案驗，得其主守盜十金罪，收捕。
units.en: Yewang directed his regional inspector clerk Zhao Du of Duiyu to investigate; he proved Bing's crime of embezzling ten jin of gold while in office, and arrested him.
units.literal: Yewang ordered his regional inspector clerk to display the case to Zhao Du of Shuyi for investigation; obtaining proof of Bing's crime of guarding office property and stealing ten jin of gold, he arrested him.

units.zh: 並不首吏，都格殺。
units.en: Bing resisted arrest and Du killed him in the scuffle.
units.literal: Bing would not submit to the clerks; Du struck and killed him.

units.zh: 並家上書陳冤，事下廷尉。
units.en: Bing's kin appealed; the file went to the commandant of justice.
units.literal: Bing's family submitted a memorial stating grievance; the matter went down to the commandant of justice.

units.zh: 都詣吏自殺以明野王，京師稱其威信，遷為大鴻臚。
units.en: Du killed himself at the yamen gate to spare Yewang; the capital praised his loyalty and promoted Yewang to grand herald.
units.literal: Du went to the clerks and committed suicide to clear Yewang; the capital praised his trustworthiness and awe, and Yewang was promoted grand herald.

units.zh: 數年，御史大夫李延壽病卒，在位多舉野王。
units.en: When Counselor Li Yanshou died, the bureaucracy backed Yewang.
units.literal: Several years later Imperial Counselor Li Yanshou died of illness; many in office recommended Yewang.

units.zh: 上使尚書選第中二千石，而野王行能第一。
units.en: The emperor ordered the secretariat to rank the two-thousand-bushel corps; Yewang topped the list.
units.literal: The emperor had the secretariat rank the full two-thousand-bushel officials; Yewang's conduct and ability were first.

units.zh: 上曰：「吾用野王為三公，後世必謂我私後宮親屬，以野王為比。」
units.en: The emperor said, "If I name him one of the Three Dukes, posterity will say I bought favor for the harem."
units.literal: The emperor said, "If We employ Yewang among the three dukes, later generations will surely say We favored inner-palace kin, taking Yewang as the precedent."

units.zh: 乃下詔曰：「剛強堅固，確然亡欲，大鴻臚野王是也。
units.en: So he issued a litany of virtues: "Grand Herald Yewang is granite and free of appetite;
units.literal: Thereupon he issued an edict, saying, "Rigid and firm, steadfastly without desire—Grand Herald Yewang is such.

units.zh: 心辨善辭，可使四方，少府五鹿充宗是也。
units.en: Wulu Chongzong has a ready tongue for embassies;
units.literal: Mind discerning and skilled in speech, able to be sent to the four quarters—Junior Privy Treasurer Wulu Chongzong is such.

units.zh: 廉潔節儉，太子少傅張譚是也。
units.en: Zhang Tan is clean and spare;
units.literal: Incorrupt and frugal—Junior tutor to the heir apparent Zhang Tan is such.

units.zh: 其以少傅為御史大夫。」
units.en: let the junior tutor take the counselor's seal."
units.literal: Let the junior tutor become imperial counselor."

units.zh: 上繇下第而用譚，越次避嫌不用野王，以昭儀兄故也。
units.en: He picked lower-ranked Zhang Tan to dodge the charge of nepotism—Yewang was the Brilliant Companion's brother.
units.literal: The emperor for this reason used Tan, who had ranked low, skipping order to avoid suspicion and not employing Yewang, because he was the elder brother of the Brilliant Companion.

units.zh: 野王乃歎曰：「人皆以女寵貴，我兄弟獨以賤！」
units.en: Yewang sighed and said, "Others all rise through a daughter's favor; we brothers alone are brought low by it!"
units.literal: Yewang thereupon sighed, saying, "Others all become noble through a woman's favor; we brothers alone are brought low by it!"

units.zh: 野王雖不為三公，甚見器重，有名當世。
units.en: He never took a ducal chair yet remained indispensable and famous.
units.literal: Although Yewang did not become one of the three dukes, he was greatly valued and esteemed and had a name in his generation.

units.zh: 成帝立，有司奏野王王舅，不宜備九卿，以秩出為上郡太守，加賜黃金百斤。
units.en: At Cheng's accession the ministries barred maternal uncles from the nine ministers; Yewang went to Shang commandery with a hundred jin of gold as consolation.
units.literal: When Emperor Cheng was established, the offices reported that Yewang, as the king's maternal uncle, was not fit to fill one of the nine ministers; by rank he was sent out as governor of Shang commandery, with an added gift of one hundred jin of gold.

units.zh: 朔方刺史蕭育奏封事，薦言：「野王行能高妙，內足與圖身，外足以慮化。
units.en: Xiao Yu, regional inspector of Shuofang, submitted a sealed memorial recommending him: "Yewang's conduct and ability are lofty and refined. At court he is capable of assisting in plans for the ruler; in the provinces he is capable of thinking through moral transformation.
units.literal: The regional inspector of Shuofang, Xiao Yu, submitted a sealed memorial recommending, saying, "Yewang's conduct and ability are lofty and subtle; inwardly sufficient to plan for the self, outwardly sufficient to consider transformation.

units.zh: 竊惜野王懷國之寶，而不得陪朝廷與朝者並。
units.en: he mourned that such a jewel stood outside the hall;
units.literal: Your servant privately pities Yewang for cherishing the state's treasure yet not being able to stand in court with those who attend audience.

units.zh: 野王前以王舅出，以賢復入，明國家樂進賢也。」
units.en: to recall him for talent would prove the court loves worth over kin."
units.literal: Yewang earlier went out because he was the king's maternal uncle; now to re-enter on account of worth shows that the state delights in advancing the worthy."

units.zh: 上自為太子時聞知野王。
units.en: Cheng had admired Yewang since his own princedom.
units.literal: The emperor had known of Yewang since he himself was heir apparent.

units.zh: 會其病免，復以故二千石使行河堤，因拜為琅邪太守。
units.en: When illness cashiered him, the court sent him, still at two-thousand-bushel rank, to inspect dikes, then named him governor of Langye.
units.literal: It happened that he was dismissed on illness; again, as a former two-thousand-bushel official, he was sent to inspect the river dikes, and thereupon was appointed governor of Langye.

units.zh: 是時，成帝長舅陽平侯王鳳為大司馬大將軍，輔政八九年矣，時數有災異，京兆尹王章譏鳳專權不可任用，薦野王代鳳。
units.en: Wang Feng, Cheng's senior uncle, had run the state nearly a decade when capital governor Wang Zhang attacked his monopoly and nominated Yewang to replace him.
units.literal: At that time the emperor's senior maternal uncle, Marquis of Yangping Wang Feng, was grand marshal and great general, aiding the government eight or nine years; at the time there were frequent disasters and prodigies; the governor of the capital, Wang Zhang, ridiculed Feng as wielding sole power unfit for employment, and recommended Yewang to replace Feng.

units.zh: 上初納其言，而後誅章，語在《元后傳》。
units.en: The throne first agreed, then executed Wang Zhang—the tale is told with the Yuan empress.
units.literal: The emperor at first accepted his words, but afterward executed Zhang—the account is in the "Biography of the Yuan Empress Dowager."

units.zh: 於是野王懼不自安，遂病，滿三月賜告，與妻子歸杜陵就醫藥。
units.en: Yewang grew terrified, took three months' medical leave, and fled to Duling with his family.
units.literal: Thereupon Yewang was afraid and not at ease in himself; he fell ill, and when three months of sick leave were granted, he went with wife and children to Duling to seek medicine.

units.zh: 大將軍鳳風御史中丞劾奏野王賜告養病而私自便，持虎符出界歸家，奉詔不敬。
units.en: Feng nudged the palace secretary to charge that Yewang had abused sick leave, crossed out of his command with the tiger tally, and insulted imperial grace.
units.literal: Great general Feng hinted to the palace secretary to memorialize impeachment: Yewang had received granted sick leave to nurse illness but privately took convenience, held the tiger tally and crossed the boundary to return home—disrespect to an edict.

units.zh: 杜欽時在大將軍莫府，欽素高野王父子行能，奏記於鳳，為野王言曰：「竊見令曰，吏二千石告，過長安謁，不分別予賜。
units.en: Du Qin, in Feng's staff, argued the statute: two-thousand-bushel men passing through the capital on leave were not split between "ordinary" and "granted" sick leave;
units.literal: Du Qin was then in the great general's headquarters; Qin had always esteemed the conduct and ability of Yewang and his father, and submitted a note to Feng, speaking for Yewang, saying, "Your servant has seen in the ordinance that when officials of two thousand bushels take leave and pass through Chang'an to audience, it does not distinguish granting ordinary versus granted sick leave.

units.zh: 今有司以為予告得歸，賜告不得，是一律兩科，失省刑之意。
units.en: treating the two differently was one law with two faces and betrayed the spirit of merciful judgment;
units.literal: Now the offices hold that ordinary leave may return home but granted sick leave may not—this is one statute with two grades and loses the meaning of reviewing punishments.

units.zh: 夫三最予告，令也；
units.en: top-rated merit leave was statute;
units.literal: The three highest ratings granting ordinary leave is ordinance;

units.zh: 病滿三月賜告，詔恩也。
units.en: three months' imperial sick leave was grace;
units.literal: sick leave of three months granted is edict grace.

units.zh: 令告則得，詔恩不得，失輕重之差。
units.en: to honor one and forbid the other skewed weight and weightlessness;
units.literal: Ordinance allows it but edict grace does not—this misses the balance of light and heavy.

units.zh: 又二千石病賜告得歸有故事，不得去郡亡著令。
units.en: precedent let sick two-thousand-bushel men go home, and no written rule barred leaving the command.
units.literal: Moreover for two-thousand-bushel illness with granted leave to return home there is precedent; there is no written ordinance forbidding leaving the commandery.

units.zh: 傳曰：『賞疑從予，所以廣恩勸功也；
units.en: The tradition runs, "If reward is doubtful, give—thus widening grace;
units.literal: Tradition says, "When reward is doubtful, incline to grant—thereby broadening grace and encouraging merit;

units.zh: 罰疑從去，所以慎刑，闕難知也。』
units.en: if punishment is doubtful, withhold—thus sparing the blade for gray cases."
units.literal: when punishment is doubtful, incline to remit—thereby being careful with punishments and leaving what is hard to know."

units.zh: 今釋令與故事而假不敬之法，甚違闕疑從去之意。
units.en: To scrap precedent for a vague "disrespect" charge betrayed that maxim.
units.literal: Now to discard ordinance and precedent and borrow the law of irreverence greatly violates the meaning of "when punishment is doubtful, remit.

units.zh: 即以二千石守千里之地，任兵馬之重，不宜去郡，將以制刑為後法者，則野王之罪，在未制令前也。
units.en: Even if a new rule should chain governors to their posts, Yewang acted before any such rule existed.
units.literal: Even if, because a two-thousand-bushel guards a thousand li of territory and bears the weight of arms and horses, he ought not leave the commandery, intending to make punishment regulation for later law—then Yewang's offense lies before the ordinance was made.

units.zh: 刑賞大信，不可不慎。」
units.en: Reward and punishment are the throne's bond with the realm—handle them with care."
units.literal: Punishment and reward are great trust—they cannot but be careful."

units.zh: 鳳不聽，竟免野王。
units.en: Feng ignored him and cashiered Yewang anyway.
units.literal: Feng would not listen and in the end dismissed Yewang.

units.zh: 郡國二千石病賜告不得歸家，自此始。
units.en: From that day governors on sick leave could not go home.
units.literal: That commandery and kingdom two-thousand-bushels on granted sick leave could not return home began from this.

units.zh: 初，野王嗣父爵為關內侯，免歸。
units.en: Yewang had earlier inherited marquis-within-the-passes rank and lost it.
units.literal: Earlier, Yewang had inherited his father's rank as marquis within the passes and been dismissed to return home.

units.zh: 數年，年老，終於家。
units.en: Years later he died at home in old age.
units.literal: Several years later, old in years, he ended at home.

units.zh: 子座嗣爵，至孫坐中山太后事絕。
units.en: Son Zuo inherited until a grandson lost the title in the Zhongshan dowager scandal.
units.literal: His son Zuo inherited the rank; reaching the grandson, it was cut off on account of the affair of the grand empress dowager of Zhongshan.

units.zh: 逡字子產，通《易》，太常察孝廉為郎，補謁者。
units.en: Qun, style Zichan, knew the Changes, entered as filial and incorrupt, and became a yeoman.
units.literal: Qun, courtesy name Zichan, was conversant with the Changes; the Grand Master of ceremonies inspected him as filial and incorrupt and he became a gentleman, supplemented yeoman.

units.zh: 建昭中，選為復土校尉。
units.en: In Jianzhao he was picked as colonel of the burial mounds.
units.literal: In the Jianzhao period he was selected colonel of the burial mounds.

units.zh: 光祿勳於永舉茂材，為美陽令。
units.en: Yu Yong nominated him flourishing talent for Meiyang.
units.literal: Superintendent of the household Yu Yong recommended him as flourishing talent, and he became magistrate of Meiyang.

units.zh: 功次遷長樂屯衛司馬，清河都尉，隴西太守。
units.en: Merit raised him to Changle garrison marshal, Qinghe chief commandant, and Longxi governor.
units.literal: By order of merit he was promoted garrison marshal of Changle, chief commandant of Qinghe, and governor of Longxi.

units.zh: 治行廉平，年四十餘卒。
units.en: He governed cleanly and died in his forties.
units.literal: His administration was incorrupt and even; he died past forty.

units.zh: 為都尉時，言河堤方略，在《溝洫志》。
units.en: As chief commandant he wrote on flood control—see the "Treatise on Ditches and Channels."
units.literal: When he was chief commandant he spoke on river-dike strategy; it is in the "Treatise on Ditches and Channels."

units.zh: 立字聖卿，通《春秋》。
units.en: Li, style Shengqing, mastered the Spring and Autumn.
units.literal: Li, courtesy name Shengqing, was conversant with the Spring and Autumn Annals.

units.zh: 以父任為郎，稍遷諸曹。
units.en: Yin privilege made him a gentleman; he climbed the bureau ladder.
units.literal: By his father's privilege he became a gentleman and gradually was promoted among the various bureaus.

units.zh: 竟寧中，以王舅出為五原屬國都尉。
units.en: Jingning sent him, as the prince's uncle, to command Wuyuan dependent state.
units.literal: In the Jingning period, because he was the king's maternal uncle, he went out as chief commandant of the dependent state of Wuyuan.

units.zh: 數年，遷五原太守，徙西河、上郡。
units.en: He rose to Wuyuan governor, then Xihe and Shang.
units.literal: After several years he was promoted governor of Wuyuan, then transferred to Xihe and Shang commanderies.

units.zh: 立居職公廉，治行略與野王相似，而多知有恩貸，好為條教。
units.en: Like Yewang he was just, but kinder with forbearance and fonder of written instructions.
units.literal: Li in office was fair and incorrupt; his administration was broadly similar to Yewang's, but he knew more and showed kindness in loans, liking to issue detailed instructions.

units.zh: 吏民嘉美野王、立相代為太守，歌之曰：「大馮君，小馮君，兄弟繼踵相因循，聰明賢知惠吏民，政如魯、衛德化鈞，周公、康叔猶二君。」
units.en: Officials and commoners praised them in song: "Great lord Feng, little lord Feng, the brothers follow heel to heel in succession; wise and worthy, kind to officials and people; government like Lu and Wei, transformation even—the dukes of Zhou and Kangshu, still two lords."
units.literal: Officials and commoners praised Yewang and Li succeeding each other as governors, singing, "Great lord Feng, little lord Feng, brothers following heel to heel in succession, wise and worthy, kind to officials and common people; government like Lu and Wei, transformation even; the dukes of Zhou and Kangshu—still two lords."

units.zh: 後遷為東海太守，下濕病痺。
units.en: Promotion to Donghai left him crippled by damp.
units.literal: Later he was promoted governor of Donghai; the low dampness brought arthritic paralysis.

units.zh: 天子聞之，徙立為太原太守。
units.en: The emperor moved him to the dry climate of Taiyuan.
units.literal: When the Son of Heaven heard it, he transferred Li to be governor of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 更歷五郡，所居有跡。
units.en: Five commands in a row felt his mark.
units.literal: He passed through five commanderies in succession; wherever he dwelt he left a record.

units.zh: 年老卒官。
units.en: He died in harness, full of years.
units.literal: Old in years, he died in office.

units.zh: 參字叔平，學通《尚書》。
units.en: Shen, style Shuping, mastered the Documents.
units.literal: Shen, courtesy name Shuping, studied until he was thoroughly versed in the Documents.

units.zh: 少為黃門郎給事中，宿衛十餘年，參為人矜嚴，好修容儀，進退恂恂，甚可觀也。
units.en: As a youth he served as yellow-gate gentleman and attendant within the gates, on night watch for more than ten years. Stern and dignified, he cultivated his bearing; his measured advance and retreat were a sight to behold.
units.literal: In youth he was a yellow-gate gentleman attendant within the gates; he kept night watch for more than ten years. Shen was by nature stern and dignified, fond of cultivating deportment; in advance and retreat he was measured and respectful—a sight very much worth seeing.

units.zh: 參，昭儀少弟，行又敕備，以嚴見憚，終不得親近侍帷幄。
units.en: Shen was the Brilliant Companion's younger brother; his conduct was meticulous. His severity inspired fear, and he never drew near to serve within the curtained chambers.
units.literal: Shen was the younger brother of the Brilliant Companion; his conduct was moreover careful and complete. Because of his severity he was feared, and in the end he could not draw near to attend within the curtained chambers.

units.zh: 竟寧中，以王舅出補渭陵食官令。
units.en: In Jingning, as the prince's uncle, he was posted overseer of provisions at Weiling.
units.literal: In the Jingning period, as the king's maternal uncle he went out to be appointed overseer of provisions at Weiling.

units.zh: 以數病徙為寢中郎，有詔勿事。
units.en: Repeated illness moved him to gentleman of the imperial tomb, with an edict excusing him from duties.
units.literal: Because of repeated illness he was transferred to gentleman of the imperial tomb; an edict ordered that he perform no duties.

units.zh: 陽朔中，中山王來朝，參擢為上河農都尉。
units.en: During Yangshuo, when the King of Zhongshan came to court, Shen was raised to chief agricultural commandant of Shanghe.
units.literal: In the Yangshuo period, when the King of Zhongshan came to court, Shen was promoted chief agricultural commandant of Shanghe.

units.zh: 病免官，復為渭陵寢中郎。
units.en: Illness ended his post; he returned as gentleman of the Weiling imperial tomb.
units.literal: Illness freed him from office; he again became gentleman of the Weiling imperial tomb.

units.zh: 永始中，超遷代郡太守。
units.en: In Yongshi he was leap-promoted to governor of Dai.
units.literal: In the Yongshi period he was promoted in exceptional leap to governor of Dai commandery.

units.zh: 以邊郡道遠，徙為安定太守。
units.en: The distant frontier route got him transferred to Anding governor.
units.literal: Because the frontier commandery's route was distant, he was transferred to governor of Anding.

units.zh: 數歲，病免，復為諫大夫，使領護左馮翊都水。
units.en: Years later illness ended his term; he became grandee remonstrant and oversaw Left Fengyi waterways.
units.literal: Several years later, illness freed him; he again became grandee remonstrant and was sent to oversee the waterways of Left Fengyi.

units.zh: 綏和中，立定陶王為皇太子，以中山王見廢，故封王舅參為宜鄉侯，以慰王意。
units.en: In Suihe the King of Dingtao became heir apparent; with Zhongshan deposed, the prince's uncle Shen was made Marquis of Yixiang to soothe him.
units.literal: In the Suihe period the King of Dingtao was established as heir apparent. Because the King of Zhongshan had been deposed, the king's maternal uncle Shen was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yixiang to comfort the king's feelings.

units.zh: 參之國，上書願至中山見王、太后。
units.en: Going to his fief, Shen memorialized asking to visit Zhongshan and see the king and dowager.
units.literal: When Shen went to his state, he submitted a memorial wishing to go to Zhongshan to see the king and the grand empress dowager.

units.zh: 行未到而王薨。
units.en: He had not yet arrived when the king died.
units.literal: Before he arrived on the journey, the king died.

units.zh: 王病時，上奏願貶參爵以關內侯食邑留長安。
units.en: While ill, the king asked that Shen's rank be reduced to marquis within the passes with his fief kept at Chang'an.
units.literal: When the king was ill, he submitted a memorial wishing to demote Shen's rank to marquis within the passes with a fiefdom left at Chang'an.

units.zh: 上憐之，下詔曰：「中山孝王短命早薨，願以舅宜鄉侯參為關內侯，歸家，朕甚愍之。
units.en: The emperor pitied him and issued an edict: "The Filial King of Zhongshan died young. He wished his uncle, Marquis of Yixiang Shen, made marquis within the passes and sent home. We are deeply moved.
units.literal: The emperor pitied him and issued an edict, saying, "The Filial King of Zhongshan died young before his time. He wished that his maternal uncle, Marquis of Yixiang Shen, be made marquis within the passes and return home. We are deeply moved.

units.zh: 其還參京師，以列侯奉朝請。」
units.en: Let Shen return to the capital and attend court as a full marquis."
units.literal: Let Shen return to the capital to attend court at morning audience as a full marquis."

units.zh: 五侯皆敬憚之。
units.en: The Five Marquises all respected and feared him.
units.literal: The Five Marquises all respected and feared him.

units.zh: 丞相翟方進亦甚重焉，數謂參：「物禁太甚。
units.en: Chancellor Zhai Fangjin also esteemed him and often told Shen, "Things forbid excess.
units.literal: Chancellor Zhai Fangjin also thought highly of him and repeatedly told Shen, "Things forbid excess.

units.zh: 君侯以王舅見廢，不得在公卿位，今五侯至尊貴也，與之並列，宜少詘節卑體，視有所宗。
units.en: You, my lord, as the deposed king's uncle, could not hold ministerial rank. The Five Marquises are supreme; standing among them, you should bend your manner and show deference to someone above you.
units.literal: You, my lord, as the deposed king's maternal uncle, could not hold a ministerial post. Now the Five Marquises are supremely exalted; standing among them on equal footing, you ought to bend your manner somewhat and lower your body, showing that you have someone to look up to.

units.zh: 而君侯盛修容貌以威嚴加之，此非所以下五侯而自益者也。」
units.en: Yet you lavishly groom your appearance and add severity on top—that is not how to place yourself below the Five Marquises and help yourself."
units.literal: Yet you, my lord, lavishly cultivate your appearance and pile severity on top—this is not the way to place yourself below the Five Marquises and benefit yourself."

units.zh: 參性好禮儀，終不改其恆操。
units.en: Shen loved ritual and decorum and never changed his steady ways.
units.literal: Shen's nature loved ritual and decorum; to the end he did not alter his constant conduct.

units.zh: 頃之，哀帝即位，帝祖母傅太后用事，追怨參姊中山太后，陷以祝詛大逆之罪，語在《外戚傳》。
units.en: Soon Ai ruled; Grand Empress Dowager Fu hated Shen's sister, the Zhongshan dowager, and framed her for witchcraft—see the outer-kin annals.
units.literal: Before long Emperor Ai ascended the throne; the emperor's grandmother Grand Empress Dowager Fu held power, nursed resentment against Shen's elder sister the grand empress dowager of Zhongshan, and trapped her with the great irreverence charge of curse-praying—the account is in the "Biography of the Outer Kin."

units.zh: 參以同產當相坐，謁者承製召參詣廷尉，參自殺。
units.en: Shen faced kin liability; the usher's summons to the commandant of justice drove him to suicide.
units.literal: Shen, as born of the same womb, was to suffer joint liability; the yeoman, carrying the edict, summoned Shen to the commandant of justice, and Shen killed himself.

units.zh: 且死，仰天歎曰：「參父子兄弟皆備大位，身至封侯，今被惡名而死，姊弟不敢自惜，傷無以見先人於地下！」
units.en: About to die, he sighed toward heaven and said, "My father, brothers, and I have all filled high posts and attained marquis rank; now I die bearing a foul name. Sister and brother—I do not pity ourselves; I grieve only that we cannot face our ancestors underground!"
units.literal: About to die, he sighed toward heaven, saying, "My father, brothers, and I have all filled high posts and attained marquis rank; now I die bearing a foul name. Sister and brother—I do not pity ourselves; I grieve only that we cannot face our ancestors underground!"

units.zh: 死者十七人，眾莫不憐之。
units.en: Seventeen lives ended; the realm wept for them.
units.literal: Seventeen died; none among the multitude did not pity them.

units.zh: 宗族徙歸故郡。
units.en: The clan was deported to its ancestral commandery.
units.literal: The lineage was moved back to the old commandery.

units.zh: 贊曰：《詩》稱「抑抑威儀，惟德之隅。」
units.en: The historian cites the Odes: "Grave is the bearing that fences virtue."
units.literal: The appraising comment says: The Odes praises "solemn, solemn awe-inspiring deportment—the corner of virtue."

units.zh: 宜鄉侯參鞠躬履方，擇地而行，可謂淑人君子，然卒死於非罪，不能自免，哀哉！
units.en: Marquis Shen walked every inch by the book—a true gentleman—yet perished on a false charge he could not escape.
units.literal: Marquis of Yixiang Shen bowed the body and trod the square, choosing the ground in walking—he may be called a virtuous man and noble man, yet in the end he died of a crime he did not commit, unable to save himself—alas!

units.zh: 讒邪交亂，貞良被害，自古而然。
units.en: Slander devouring the good is as old as history.
units.literal: Slander and evil crisscrossing, the chaste and good injured—this has been so since antiquity.

units.zh: 故伯奇放流，孟子宮刑，申生雉經，屈原赴湘，《小弁》之詩作，《離騷》之辭興。
units.en: So Boqi was driven out, Mengzi was castrated, Crown Prince Sheng hanged himself, Qu Yuan drowned—the "Little Boy" ode and "Li sao" rose from such pain.
units.literal: Therefore Boqi was banished, Mengzi suffered palace castration, Sheng'er strangled with pheasant cord, Qu Yuan threw himself into the Xiang; the poem "Little Boy" was composed, the words of "Li sao" arose.

units.zh: 經曰：「心之憂矣，涕既隕之。」
units.en: The canon says, "The heart's grief already wets the cheek with tears."
units.literal: The classic says, "The heart's sorrow—tears already fall."

units.zh: 馮參姊弟，亦云悲矣！
units.en: Shen and his sister—pitiful indeed.
units.literal: Shen's elder sister and younger brother—one may also say it was pitiful!

units.zh: 五月，封舅曼子侍中騎都尉光祿大夫王莽為新都侯。
units.en: In the fifth month, maternal uncle Man's son Wang Mang, Attendant at the Palace and Cavalry Commandant Guanglu Grandee, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xindu.
units.literal: Fifth month, enfeoffed maternal uncle Man son Attendant at the Palace Cavalry Commandant Guanglu Grandee Wang Mang as Xindu Marquis.

units.zh: 成王不疑周公，孝昭委任霍光，各因其時以成名，大矣哉！
units.en: King Cheng did not doubt the Duke of Zhou; Emperor Zhao entrusted Huo Guang with power. Each, in his own time, achieved renown thereby. How great this was!
units.literal: King Cheng did not doubt the Duke of Zhou; Emperor Zhao the Filial entrusted power to Huo Guang—each in his time achieved renown thereby. How great!

units.zh: 武都氐人反，遣執金吾馬適建、龍镪侯韓增、大鴻臚廣明將三輔、太常徒，皆免刑擊之。
units.en: The Di people of Wudu rebelled. Commander of the Guards Ma Shijian, Marquis of Longqiang Han Zeng, and Grand Herald Guangming were sent to lead convict laborers from the Three Adjuncts and the office of the Grand Minister of Ceremonies—all exempted from their punishments—to attack them.
units.literal: The Di people of Wudu rebelled; dispatched Commander of the Guards Ma Shijian, Marquis of Longqiang Han Zeng, and Grand Herald Guangming to lead convict laborers of the Three Adjuncts and Grand Minister of Ceremonies, all exempted from punishment, to attack them.

units.zh: 孝昭皇帝，武帝少子也。
units.en: Emperor Zhao, the Filial, was Emperor Wu's youngest son.
units.literal: Filial Emperor Zhao, Emperor Wu youngest son also.

units.zh: 舉賢良文學，問民所疾苦，議鹽鐵而罷榷酤，尊號曰「昭」，不亦宜乎！
units.en: Worthy and good men and literary scholars were recommended, the people's grievances were investigated, the debates on salt and iron led to the abolition of the liquor monopoly, and the honored title "Zhao" was bestowed—is this not most fitting!
units.literal: Worthy and good men and literary scholars were recommended; the people's sufferings were inquired into; salt and iron monopolies were debated and the liquor excise abolished; the honored title "Zhao" was applied—is this not fitting!

units.zh: 武帝末，戾太子 敗，燕王旦、廣陵王胥行驕嫚，後元二年二月上疾病，遂立昭帝為太子，年八歲。
units.en: Late in Emperor Wu's reign, after the defeat of Crown Prince Li, King Dan of Yan and King Xu of Guangling both acted with arrogance and contempt. In the second month of Houyuan 2, when Emperor Wu fell ill, he made the future Emperor Zhao crown prince; Zhao was eight years old.
units.literal: In Emperor Wu's later years, after Crown Prince Li was defeated, King Dan of Yan and King Xu of Guangling behaved arrogantly and insolently. In the second month of the second year of Houyuan, when the emperor fell ill, he established Zhao as crown prince at age eight.

units.zh: 戊辰，太子 即皇帝位，謁高廟。
units.en: On the Wuchen day, the crown prince ascended the imperial throne and paid respects at the High Temple.
units.literal: Wuchen day, crown prince ascended emperor position, paid respects at high temple.

units.zh: 母曰趙婕妤，本以有奇異得幸，及生帝，亦奇異。
units.en: His mother was Lady Zhao, a concubine who had gained favor through her extraordinary qualities, and the circumstances of his birth were also extraordinary.
units.literal: Mother called Zhao Jieyu, originally by having extraordinary gained favor, and when gave birth to emperor, also extraordinary.

units.zh: 帝姊鄂邑公主益湯沐邑，為長公主，共養省中。
units.en: The emperor's elder sister, Princess Eyi, had her bath fief increased and was made Elder Princess; she and others jointly raised and cared for the emperor in the inner palace.
units.literal: The emperor's elder sister, Princess Eyi, had her bath fief increased and was made Elder Princess, and together they cared for the emperor in the inner palace.

units.zh: 四年春三月甲寅，立皇后上官氏。
units.en: In the third month of spring in the fourth year, on a jiayin day, Lady Shangguan was established as empress.
units.literal: Fourth year, spring, third month, Jiayin day: Lady Shangguan was established as empress.

units.zh: 始元元年春二月，黃鵠下建章宮太液池中。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the first year of the Shiyuan era, a yellow swan descended into the Taiye Pool of Jianzhang Palace.
units.literal: First year of Shiyuan reign, spring second month: Yellow swan descended in Jianzhang Palace's Taiye Pool.

units.zh: 元鳳元年春，長公主共養勞苦，復以藍田益長公主湯沐邑。
units.en: In spring of the first year of Yuanfeng, because the Elder Princess had labored bitterly in raising the emperor together with others, Lantian was added to increase her bath fief.
units.literal: Yuanfeng first year spring, elder princess together raised toilsome bitter, again with Lantian increased elder princess bath fief.

units.zh: 九月，鄂邑長公主、燕王旦與左將軍上官桀、桀子票騎將軍安、御史大夫桑弘羊皆謀反，伏誅。
units.en: In the ninth month, the Elder Princess of Eyi, King Dan of Yan, Left General Shangguan Jie, Jie's son Flying Cavalry General An, and Imperial Secretary Sang Hongyang all plotted rebellion and were executed.
units.literal: Ninth month, Eyi Elder Princess, Yan King Dan with Left General Shangguan Jie, Jie son Flying Cavalry General An, Imperial Secretary Sang Hongyang all plotted rebellion, suffered execution.

units.zh: 夏四月癸未，帝崩于未央宮。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on a Guiwei day, the Emperor passed away in Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Summer fourth month Guiwei: Emperor passed away in Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 時上年十四，覺其詐。
units.en: At that time the emperor was fourteen years old and perceived their deception.
units.literal: At that time emperor age fourteen, perceived their deception.

units.zh: 六月壬申，葬平陵。
units.en: In the sixth month, on a Renshen day, he was buried at Pingling.
units.literal: Sixth month Renshen: Buried at Pingling.

units.zh: 秋八月，詔曰：「往年災害多，今年蠶麥傷，所振貸種、食勿收責，毋令民出今年田租。」
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, an edict stated: 'Previous years had many disasters, this year the silkworms and wheat have been damaged. The relief aid and loans for seed and food are not to be collected, nor are the people to pay this year's land taxes.'
units.literal: Autumn eighth month, edict said: Previous years disasters many, this year silkworm wheat harmed, what relieved loaned seed, food do not collect responsibility, do not make people pay this year field rent.

units.zh: 秋七月，詔曰：「比歲不登，民匱於食，流庸未盡還，往時令民共出馬，其止勿出。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, an edict stated: 'In recent years the harvests have failed, the people lack food, and the wandering laborers have not all returned. The previous order requiring the people to provide horses jointly is hereby rescinded.
units.literal: Autumn seventh month, edict said: In recent years harvests have failed, the people lack food, wandering laborers have not all returned; the previous order requiring the people jointly to provide horses—stop it, do not require it.

units.zh: 諸給中都官者，且減之。」
units.en: Supplies furnished to officials of the central court shall be reduced for the time being.'
units.literal: All supplies to the central court officials, for the time being reduce them."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以眇身獲保宗廟，戰戰栗栗，夙興夜寐，修古帝王之事，通保傅，傳孝經、論語、尚書，未云有明。
units.en: An edict stated: 'Though I am but one of slight stature who has been fortunate enough to preserve the ancestral temples, I tremble with fear and rise early and retire late, cultivating the ways of the ancient emperors and kings. I have studied with my tutors the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, and the Documents, but I cannot yet claim to have attained clarity.
units.literal: Edict said: I, with my slight person, have obtained the preservation of the ancestral temples; trembling with fear, I rise early and retire late, cultivating the affairs of the ancient emperors and kings. I have studied with my tutors and been taught the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, and the Documents, yet I cannot say I have clarity.

units.zh: 其令三輔、太常舉賢良各二人，郡國文學高第各一人。
units.en: The Three Adjuncts and the Grand Master of Ceremonies were ordered to recommend two worthy and good men each, while the commanderies and kingdoms were to recommend one literary scholar of the highest rank each.
units.literal: Order the Three Adjuncts and Grand Master of Ceremonies to recommend worthy and good men, two each; commanderies and kingdoms to recommend literary scholars of highest rank, one each.

units.zh: 賜中二千石以下至吏民爵各有差。」
units.en: Officials ranked at 2000 piculs and below, down to minor officials and common people, were granted noble ranks according to their respective merits.'
units.literal: Granted officials of 2000 piculs and below down to officials and commoners noble ranks, each according to degree."

units.zh: 詔曰：「鉤町侯毋波率其君長人民擊反者，斬首捕虜有功。
units.en: An edict stated: 'Marquis Wu Bo of Goutian led his chiefs and people to attack the rebels, achieving merit in beheading and capturing them.
units.literal: Edict said: Goutian marquis Wu Bo led his chiefs people attacked rebels, beheaded captured meritorious.

units.zh: 其立毋波為鉤町王。
units.en: Therefore, Wu Bo was established as King of Goutian.
units.literal: Therefore established Wu Bo as Goutian king.

units.zh: 大鴻臚廣明將率有功，賜爵關內侯，食邑。」
units.en: Grand Herald Guangming, having led troops with merit, was granted the title of Marquis within the Pass, with fief income.'
units.literal: Grand herald Guangming led troops meritorious, granted title Guannei marquis, fief income."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕閔勞以官職之事，其務修孝弟以教鄉里。
units.en: An edict declared: 'I pity those who grow weary under the burden of official duties. Let them diligently cultivate filial piety and fraternal duty to teach their villages and communities.
units.literal: Edict said: I pity those weary from the burden of official duties; let them diligently cultivate filial piety and fraternal duty to teach the villages and hamlets.

units.zh: 令郡縣常以正月賜羊酒。
units.en: Commanderies and counties were ordered to regularly grant sheep and wine in the first month of each year.
units.literal: Order commanderies and counties regularly in first month to grant sheep and wine.

units.zh: 有不幸者賜衣被一襲，祠以中牢。」
units.en: Those who suffered misfortune were to be granted one set of clothing and bedding, and sacrifices were to be offered with the middle grade of sacrificial animals.'
units.literal: Those who meet misfortune grant one suit of clothes and covering, sacrifice with middle sacrificial offering."

units.zh: 冬十月，詔曰：「左將軍安陽侯桀、票騎將軍桑樂侯安、御史大夫弘羊皆數以邪枉干輔政，大將軍不聽， 而懷怨望，與燕王通謀，置驛往來相約結。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, an edict stated: 'Left General Marquis Jie of Anyang, Flying Cavalry General Marquis An of Sang Le, and Imperial Secretary Hongyang all repeatedly interfered in the auxiliary government with crooked and perverse actions. The Grand General would not listen, so they harbored resentment and communicated with King Yan in plotting, establishing post stations for coming and going and mutually agreeing to join together.
units.literal: Winter tenth month, edict said: Left general Anyang marquis Jie, flying cavalry general Sang Le marquis An, imperial secretary Hongyang all repeatedly with crooked perverse interfered auxiliary government, grand general not listen, and harbored resentment, with Yan King communicated plotted, established post stations come go mutually agreed joined.

units.zh: 燕王遣壽西長、孫縱之等賂遺長公主、丁外人、謁者杜延年、大將軍長史公孫遺等，交通私書，共謀令長公主置酒，伏兵 殺大將軍光，徵立燕王為天子，大逆毋道。
units.en: King Yan sent Shou Xichang, Sun Zongzhi, and others to bribe and give gifts to the Elder Princess, Ding Wai, Usher Du Yannian, the Grand General's Chief Secretary Gongsun Yi, and others. They communicated with private letters and together plotted to have the Elder Princess host a wine banquet with ambush troops to kill Grand General Guang, and summon and establish King Yan as Son of Heaven - a great rebellion against the proper way.
units.literal: Yan King sent Shou Xichang, Sun Zongzhi etc. bribed gave elder princess, Ding outsider, usher Du Yannian, grand general chief secretary Gongsun Yi etc., communicated private letters, together plotted made elder princess set wine, ambush troops kill grand general Guang, summoned established Yan King as heavenly son, great rebellion without way.

units.zh: 故稻田使者燕倉先發覺，以告大司農敞，敞告諫大夫延年，延年以聞。
units.en: The former rice field envoy Yan Cang first discovered this and informed Grand Minister of Agriculture Chang. Chang informed Remonstrance Grand Master Yannian, who reported it to the emperor.
units.literal: Former rice field envoy Yan Cang first discovered, with told grand minister agriculture Chang, Chang told remonstrance Grand Master Yannian, Yannian with heard.

units.zh: 丞相徵事任宮手捕斬桀，丞相少史王壽誘將安入府 門，皆已伏誅，吏民得以安。
units.en: The Chancellor's investigator Ren Gong personally captured and beheaded Jie. The Chancellor's junior secretary Wang Shou lured An to enter the office gate. They all suffered execution, and officials and people were thereby able to live in peace.
units.literal: Chancellor investigating affairs Ren Gong hand captured beheaded Jie, chancellor junior secretary Wang Shou lured led An entered office gate, all already suffered execution, officials people thereby able peaceful.

units.zh: 封延年、倉、宮、壽皆為列侯。」
units.en: Yannian, Cang, Gong, and Shou were all enfeoffed as marquises.'
units.literal: Enfeoffed Yannian, Cang, Gong, Shou all as marquises."

units.zh: 又曰：「燕王迷惑失道，前與齊王子劉澤等為逆，抑而不揚，望王反道自新，今乃與長公主及左將軍 桀等謀危宗廟。
units.en: The edict continued: 'The King of Yan was confused and lost his way. He had previously joined Prince Liu Ze of Qi and others in rebellion. Though this was suppressed and not widely publicized in the hope that the king would reform and return to the proper path, he has now conspired with the Long Princess and General of the Left Jie to endanger the ancestral temples.
units.literal: Further said: 'Yan King was confused and lost the Way, previously with Qi Prince Liu Ze and others committed rebellion, suppressed and not raised, hoped King would return to Way and renew himself, now instead with Long Princess and General of the Left Jie and others plotted to endanger ancestral temple.

units.zh: 王及公主皆自伏辜。
units.en: The king and the princess both submitted to punishment for their guilt.
units.literal: The king and the princess both took their guilt upon themselves.

units.zh: 其赦王太子建、公主子文信及宗室子與燕王、上官桀等謀反父母同產當坐者，皆免為庶人。
units.en: The king's heir apparent Jian, the princess's son Wenxin, and the imperial clansmen who had plotted rebellion with the King of Yan and Shangguan Jie, together with their parents and full siblings who would normally be implicated, were all pardoned and reduced to commoner status.
units.literal: Pardon the king's heir apparent Jian, the princess's son Wenxin, and the imperial clansmen who with the King of Yan and Shangguan Jie and others plotted rebellion, and their parents and full siblings who should be implicated—all reduce to commoners.

units.zh: 其吏為桀等所詿誤，未發覺在吏者， 除其罪。」
units.en: The officials who had been deceived and misled by Jie and his confederates, and whose involvement had not yet been discovered while they remained in office, were pardoned of their crimes."
units.literal: Their officials who were deceived and misled by Jie and others, not yet discovered while in office, remove their crimes."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕閔百姓未贍，前年減漕三百萬石。
units.en: An edict stated: 'I pity the common people who are not yet satisfied. Last year we reduced the tribute by three million shi.
units.literal: Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three million shi.

units.zh: 頗省乘輿馬及菀馬，以補邊郡三輔傳馬。
