units.en: We somewhat economized on the imperial carriage horses and park horses in order to supplement the relay horses of the border commanderies and the Three Adjuncts.
units.literal: Somewhat economized imperial carriage horses and park horses, to supplement border commanderies three adjutants relay horses.

units.zh: 其令郡國毋斂今年馬口錢，三輔、太常郡得以叔粟當賦。」
units.en: Moreover, command the commanderies and kingdoms not to collect this year's horse tax. The Three Adjuncts and the Grand Minister of Ceremonies' commandery may use coarse grain to substitute for taxes.'
units.literal: Moreover ordered commanderies kingdoms do not collect this year horse mouth money, three adjutants, grand minister ceremonies commanderies able use coarse grain substitute taxes."

units.zh: 詔曰：「乃者民被水災，頗匱於食，朕虛倉廩，使使者振困乏。
units.en: An edict stated: 'Recently the people suffered from flood disasters and are considerably lacking in food. I have emptied the granaries and sent envoys to relieve those in poverty and want.
units.literal: Edict said: Recently people suffered flood disaster, considerably lacking food, I emptied granaries, sent envoys relieved impoverished lacking.

units.zh: 其止四年毋漕。
units.en: Moreover, cease the grain transport tribute for four years.
units.literal: Moreover, stop grain transport tribute for four years.

units.zh: 三年以前所振貸，非丞相御史所請，邊郡受牛者勿收責。」
units.en: For relief and loans issued before the third year, if not requested by the chancellor or imperial secretary, do not collect repayment from those border commanderies that had received oxen.'
units.literal: For what was relieved and loaned before the third year, if not requested by the chancellor or imperial secretary, do not collect repayment from those border commanderies that received oxen."

units.zh: 夏四月，詔曰：「度遼將軍明友前以羌騎校尉將羌王侯君長以下擊益州反虜，後復率擊武都反氐，今破烏桓，斬虜獲生，有功。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, an edict stated: 'General Ming You, who crosses the Liao, previously as Qiang Cavalry Colonel led Qiang kings, marquises, and chiefs and below to attack the rebel bandits of Yizhou, and afterwards again led troops to attack the rebel Di of Wudu. Now he has defeated the Wuhuan, beheaded and captured alive, and has merit.
units.literal: Summer fourth month, edict said: Cross Liao general Ming You previously as Qiang cavalry colonel led Qiang kings marquises chiefs below attacked Yizhou rebel bandits, afterwards again led attacked Wudu rebel Di, now broken Wuhuan, beheaded captured alive, have merit.

units.zh: 其封明友為平陵侯。
units.en: Therefore, enfeoff Ming You as Marquis of Pingling.
units.literal: Therefore enfeoff Ming You as Marquis of Pingling.

units.zh: 平樂監傅介子持節使，誅斬樓蘭王安，歸首縣北闕，封義陽侯。」
units.en: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'
units.literal: Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."

units.zh: 詔曰：「夫穀賤傷農，今三輔、太常穀減賤，其令以叔粟當今年賦。」
units.en: An edict declared: 'When grain prices are too low, it harms the farmers. The grain in the Three Adjuncts and the Grand Ceremonies office has become cheaper. I order that coarse millet be accepted in lieu of this year's taxes.'
units.literal: Edict said: 'Grain being cheap harms farmers, now Three Adjuncts and Grand Ceremonies grain has decreased and is cheap, order to use coarse millet to substitute for this year's taxes.'

units.zh: 元平元年春二月，詔曰：「天下以農桑為本。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the first year of the Yuanping era, an edict declared: 'Agriculture and sericulture form the foundation of the empire.
units.literal: First year of Yuanping spring second month, edict said: 'The empire takes farming and sericulture as foundation.

units.zh: 日者省用，罷不急官，減外繇，耕桑者益眾，而百姓未能家給，朕甚愍焉。
units.en: Recently, expenditures have been reduced, non-essential offices abolished, and external corvée labor decreased. More people are engaged in farming and sericulture, yet the common people still cannot provide for their households. I am deeply troubled by this.
units.literal: Recently reduced expenditures, abolished non-urgent offices, decreased external corvée, farmers and silk producers increasingly numerous, yet common people cannot provide for their families, I greatly pity this.

units.zh: 其減口賦錢。」
units.en: The poll tax should be reduced.'
units.literal: Reduce the poll tax money.'

units.zh: 六月春正月，上耕于上林。
units.en: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.
units.literal: Sixth year spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.

units.zh: 二年夏四月，上自建章宮徙未央宮，大置酒。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the second year, His Majesty moved from Jianzhang Palace to Weiyang Palace and held a great banquet.
units.literal: Second year summer fourth month: His Majesty moved from Jianzhang Palace to Weiyang Palace, greatly prepared wine.

units.zh: 四年春正月丁亥，帝加元服，見于高廟。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on a Dinghai day, the Emperor underwent the capping ceremony and made an appearance at the Gao Temple.
units.literal: Fourth year spring first month Dinghai: Emperor added crown ceremony, appeared at Gao Temple.

units.zh: 己亥，上耕于鉤盾弄田。
units.en: On jihai day, the emperor performed the plowing ceremony at the Gou Dun Nong field.
units.literal: Jihai day, emperor plowed at Gou Dun Nong field.

units.zh: 後宮有遺腹子煖，相、內史不奏言，上聞而憐之，立煖為泗水王。
units.en: There was a posthumous son Nuan in the rear palace. The chancellor and interior minister did not report this. When the emperor heard of it, he pitied the child and established Nuan as King of Sishui.
units.literal: Rear palace had posthumous child Nuan, chancellor, interior minister not memorialized reported, emperor heard and pitied him, established Nuan as Sishui king.

units.zh: 後有譖光者，上輒怒曰：「大將軍國家忠臣，先帝所屬，敢有譖毀者，坐 之。」
units.en: Later, when anyone slandered Guang, the emperor would always say angrily, 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, entrusted with his charge by the late emperor. Anyone who dares slander him will be punished.'
units.literal: Later, when there were those who slandered Guang, the emperor would always angrily say: The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, whom the late emperor entrusted; anyone who dares to slander or defame him shall be punished.

units.zh: 五月丁丑，孝文廟正殿火，上及群臣皆素服。
units.en: On the dingchou day of the fifth month, the main hall of the Filial Wen Temple caught fire. The emperor and all ministers wore mourning clothes.
units.literal: Fifth month dingchou day, Filial Wen temple main hall fire, emperor and ministers all plain clothes.

units.zh: 有司奏請減什三，上許之。
units.en: The officials memorialized requesting that it be reduced by one-third, and His Majesty approved.
units.literal: Officials memorialized requesting reduction by one-third, His Majesty permitted it.

units.zh: 孝昭幼年即位，亦有燕、盍、上官逆亂之謀。
units.en: When Emperor Zhao the Filial ascended the throne in his youth, there were likewise conspiracies of rebellion involving King Yan, the Elder Princess, and the Shangguan faction.
units.literal: Emperor Zhao the Filial ascended the throne in his youth, and likewise there were plots of rebellion by Yan, Gai, and Shangguan.

units.zh: 孝宣承統，纂修洪業，亦講論六藝，招選茂異，而蕭望之、梁丘賀、夏侯勝、韋玄成、嚴彭祖，尹更始以儒術進，劉向，王褒以文章顯，將相則張安世、趙充國、魏相、丙吉、於定國、杜延年，治民則黃霸、王成、龔遂、鄭弘、召信臣、韓延壽、尹翁歸、趙廣漢、嚴延年、張敞之屬，皆有功跡見述於世。
units.en: Emperor Xuan inherited the succession and carried forward the great enterprise. He too expounded the Six Arts and recruited outstanding men. Xiao Wangzhi, Liangqiu He, Xiahou Sheng, Wei Xuancheng, Yan Pengzu, and Yin Gengshi advanced through Confucian learning; Liu Xiang and Wang Bao gained distinction for their writing; among the generals and chancellors were Zhang Anshi, Zhao Chongguo, Wei Xiang, Bing Ji, Yu Dingguo, and Du Yannian; and among those who governed the people were Huang Ba, Wang Cheng, Gong Sui, Zheng Hong, Shao Xinchen, Han Yanshou, Yin Wengui, Zhao Guanghan, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang, and others. All left achievements celebrated in their age.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan inherited the succession and carried forward the great enterprise. He too discussed the Six Arts and recruited outstanding men: Xiao Wangzhi, Liangqiu He, Xiahou Sheng, Wei Xuancheng, Yan Pengzu, and Yin Gengshi advanced through Confucian learning; Liu Xiang and Wang Bao gained distinction through literary composition; among the generals and chancellors were Zhang Anshi, Zhao Chongguo, Wei Xiang, Bing Ji, Yu Dingguo, and Du Yannian; among those who governed the people were Huang Ba, Wang Cheng, Gong Sui, Zheng Hong, Shao Xinchen, Han Yanshou, Yin Wengui, Zhao Guanghan, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang, and others. All had achievements recounted in their age.

units.zh: 二月壬子，丞相翟方進薨。
units.en: On Renzi of the second month, Chancellor Zhai Fangjin passed away.
units.literal: Second month Renzi, Chancellor Zhai Fangjin passed away.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 成帝末，隆奏封事言：「古老選諸侯入為公卿，以褒功德，宜徵定陶王使在國邸，以填萬方。」
units.en: Near the end of Emperor Cheng's reign, Long submitted a sealed memorial saying, "In ancient times, feudal lords were selected to enter court as dukes and ministers, in order to honor merit and virtue. The King of Dingtao should be summoned and made to stay in the state residence, thereby stabilizing all quarters."
units.literal: Near the end of Emperor Cheng's reign Long submitted a sealed memorial saying, "In high antiquity feudal lords were chosen to enter as dukes and ministers to reward merit and virtue; you should summon the King of Dingtao to lodge in the capital residence and thereby steady the four quarters."

units.zh: 其後上竟立定陶王為太子，隆遷翼州牧、穎川太守。
units.en: The emperor eventually established the King of Dingtao as crown prince; Long was promoted to Shepherd of Ji Province and Administrator of Yingchuan.
units.literal: Later the emperor did establish the King of Dingtao as heir apparent; Long was promoted to shepherd of Ji Province and governor of Yingchuan.

units.zh: 夫以四子之行，屈平之材，然猶不能自顯而被刑戮，豈不足以觀哉！
units.en: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!
units.literal: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!

units.zh: 時王祖母傅太后隨王來朝，私賂遺上所幸趙昭儀及帝舅票騎將軍曲陽侯王根。
units.en: Meanwhile, the king's grandmother, Empress Dowager Fu, had accompanied him to court and secretly bribed both the emperor's favorite, Consort Zhao, and the emperor's uncle, General Wang Gen, Marquis of Quyang.
units.literal: At this time, the king's grandmother Empress Dowager Fu accompanied the king to court and privately bribed and gifted the emperor's favored Consort Zhao and the emperor's uncle General of Chariots and Cavalry Marquis Quyang Wang Gen.

units.zh: 詔曰：「春秋『母以子貴』，尊定陶太后曰恭皇太后，丁姬曰恭皇后，各置左右詹事，食邑如長信宮、中宮。」
units.en: An imperial edict declared: 'As the Spring and Autumn Annals teach, "The mother gains honor through her son." The Empress Dowager of Dingtao shall be honored as Empress Dowager Gong, and Lady Ding as Empress Gong. Each shall have their own attendants, with estates equal to the Changxin Palace and the imperial residence.'
units.literal: An edict stated: 'The Spring and Autumn Annals say "The mother is honored through the son." Honor the Empress Dowager of Dingtao as Empress Dowager Gong, and Lady Ding as Empress Gong. Each shall have left and right palace attendants established, with fiefs equal to the Changxin Palace and the Central Palace.'

units.zh: 尊恭皇太后曰帝太太后，稱永信宮；
units.en: Empress Dowager Gong shall be honored as Imperial Grand Empress Dowager, residing in the Yongxin Palace;
units.literal: Honor Empress Dowager Gong as Imperial Grand Empress Dowager, called the Yongxin Palace;

units.zh: 癸卯，帝太太后所居桂宮正殿火。
units.en: On the day guimao, a fire broke out in the main hall of the Gui Palace, residence of the Imperial Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On the day guimao, fire in the main hall of the Gui Palace where Imperial Grand Empress Dowager resided.

units.zh: 二月，封帝太太后從弟侍中傅商為汝昌侯，太后同母弟子侍中鄭業為陽信侯。
units.en: In the second month, the emperor enfeoffed the Imperial Grand Empress Dowager's younger cousin, Chamberlain Fu Shang, as Marquis of Ruchang, and the son of the Empress Dowager's younger uterine brother, Chamberlain Zheng Ye, as Marquis of Yangxin.
units.literal: In the second month, he enfeoffed Imperial Grand Empress Dowager's younger cousin Chamberlain Fu Shang as Marquis of Ruchang, and the son of the Empress Dowager's uterine younger brother, Chamberlain Zheng Ye, as Marquis of Yangxin.

units.zh: 丁巳，皇太太后傅氏崩。
units.en: On the day dingsi, Grand Empress Dowager Fu died.
units.literal: On the day dingsi, Grand Empress Dowager Fu passed away.

units.zh: 六月，尊帝太太后為皇太太后。
units.en: In the sixth month, the Imperial Grand Empress Dowager was elevated to the title of Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: In the sixth month, he honored the Imperial Grand Empress Dowager as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 元延四年入朝，盡從傅、相、中尉。
units.en: In the fourth year of the Yuanyan era (9 BCE), he came to court accompanied by his entire retinue: his tutor, chancellor, and commandant.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyan, he came to court, his tutor, chancellor, and commandant all accompanying him.

units.zh: 杜欽說大將軍王鳳，以為「前河決，丞相史楊焉言延世受焉術以塞之，蔽不肯見。
units.en: Du Qin advised Grand General Wang Feng: "During the previous breach, Chancellor's Clerk Yang Yan said that Yanshi had used a technique learned from him to close it, but Yanshi suppressed his claim and refused to see him.
units.literal: Du Qin advised Grand General Wang Feng: "During the previous breach, Chancellor's Clerk Yang Yan said that Yanshi had used a technique learned from him to close it, but Yanshi suppressed his claim and refused to see him.

units.zh: 鳳如欽言，白遣焉等作治，六月乃成。
units.en: Wang Feng accepted Du Qin's advice, petitioned accordingly, and dispatched Yang Yan and the others. The work was completed by the sixth month.
units.literal: Feng followed Du Qin's words, memorialized and sent Yan and others to work and repair; in sixth month it was completed.

units.zh: 今獨任延世，延世見前塞之易，恐其慮害不深。
units.en: If we rely solely on Yanshi now, he may treat this as easy based on last time and underestimate the risks.
units.literal: Now relying on Yanshi alone, Yanshi seeing previous closure easy, I fear his consideration of harms is not deep.

units.zh: 又審如焉言，延世之巧，反不如焉。
units.en: And if Yang Yan's account is true, Yanshi's technique may actually be inferior to Yan's.
units.literal: If Yan's words are accurate, Yanshi's skill is in fact inferior to Yan.

units.zh: 且水勢各異，不博議利害而任一人，如使不及今冬成，來春桃華水盛，必羨溢，有填淤反壤之害。
units.en: Water conditions differ each time. If we do not debate options broadly and instead entrust one man, failure to finish before winter will invite spring peach-blossom floods, certain overtopping, and severe silt and soil damage.
units.literal: Moreover water situations vary. Without broad debate of benefits and harms and entrusting one man, if closure is not completed this winter, in spring peach-blossom flood will rise and surely overflow, with harms of silt fill and soil reversal.

units.zh: 如此，數郡種不得下，民人流散，盜賊將生，雖重誅延世，無益於事。
units.en: Then several commanderies will miss planting, populations will disperse, and banditry will emerge. Even severe punishment of Yanshi afterward would be useless.
units.literal: Thus in several commanderies planting cannot proceed, people scatter, banditry will arise. Even heavy punishment of Yanshi would not benefit affairs.

units.zh: 宜遣焉及將作大匠許商、諫大夫乘馬延年雜作。
units.en: Yang Yan should be sent to work jointly with Xu Shang, superintendent of imperial works, and Chengma Yannian, grandee of remonstrance.
units.literal: Yang Yan, Superintendent of Imperial Works Xu Shang, and Remonstrance Grandee Chengma Yannian should be sent to work jointly.

units.zh: 延世與焉必相破壞，深論便宜，以相難極。
units.en: Yanshi and Yang Yan will check one another, forcing a thorough practical debate on what should be done.
units.literal: Yanshi and Yan will surely challenge each other, deeply debating what is practical and driving arguments to the utmost.

units.zh: 商、延年皆明計算，能商功利，足以分別是非，擇其善而從之，必有成功。」
units.en: Xu Shang and Yannian are both strong in technical calculation and cost-benefit assessment. They can sort right from wrong; choose the best option and success should follow."
units.literal: Shang and Yannian both understand calculation and can weigh utility and costs, enough to distinguish right and wrong. Choose the best and follow it, and success will surely come."

units.zh: 憤馮亭之不遂兮，慍去疾之遭惑。
units.en: I rage that Feng Ting's plan miscarried and smart at Quji's fatal mistake.
units.literal: I resent Feng Ting's not succeeding—ah, I am angry at Quji's encountering delusion.

units.zh: 月餘，御史大夫於永卒，谷永上疏曰：
units.en: A month later Imperial Secretary Yu Yong died, and Gu Yong presented a memorial:
units.literal: After more than a month, Imperial Secretary Yu Yong died, and Gu Yong submitted a memorial:

units.zh: 曰：「是秦將馮無擇子也，雖賢，不能當灌嬰。
units.en: The king said: "He is the son of the Qin general Feng Wuzhe. Though capable, he cannot stand up to Guan Ying.
units.literal: He said: "He is the son of the Qin general Feng Wuzhe. Though capable, he cannot face Guan Ying.

units.zh: 梁使韓安國及楚死事相弟張羽為將軍，乃得頗敗吳兵。
units.en: Only when Liang made Han Anguo and Zhang Yu—the younger brother of Chu’s chancellor, who had died in service—generals could it begin to defeat Wu’s troops.
units.literal: Liang then made Han Anguo and Zhang Yu, younger brother of Chu's chancellor who had died in service, generals; only then were they able to inflict some defeats on the Wu army.
